title: How Jensen Huang transformed Nvidia into a tech giant: From gaming graphics to AI superpower
summary: Nvidia co-founder Jensen Huang transformed the company from a gaming graphics chipmaker into a global AI powerhouse. His early bet on GPUs, CUDA software and AI computing helped Nvidia become a critical supplier of chips and infrastructure powering the artificial intelligence boom.
